$comment: Rules for horoscope facts (gochara from the Moon sign). A graha in one of its favourable houses counted from the sign counts +weight, any other house -weight. r = sum / total weight in [-1, 1], mapped to a 5-step score by the thresholds (r <= t[0] -> 1, r <= t[1] -> 2, r < t[2] -> 3, r < t[3] -> 4, else 5).
source: Classical gochara (transit) results from the Moon sign, e.g. Phaladeepika ch. 26. Area weights are this product's convention.

review.note: Favourable houses entered from the classical lists; area weights and thresholds are a product convention. A vetted astrologer must review before horoscopes go public.

daily_moon.note: Daily: Moon weight x2 in every area; areas without the Moon get weight 1 before doubling.
